Original 1990s shonen battle-anime fighting-game artwork, with the explosive visual energy and hand-painted cel look of Dragon Ball Z era action animation. Angular expressive eyes and brows, bold economical black ink, sculpted two-tone cel shadows, pronounced but believable athletic anatomy, sharp fabric folds, dramatic foreshortening, bright golden highlights and electric cyan or magenta energy. Original cast only: preserve each supplied person's recognizable face, body build, hairstyle silhouette, clothing and accessories. Increase pointed hair clumps only where compatible with that person; do not replace their hair, outfit or identity with an existing anime character. Strong grounded fighting stances, powerful clear action silhouettes. No copied franchise characters, costumes, symbols or logos. No extra fingers, duplicated props, lettering or watermarks.
CHARACTER: The compile crusher. Short swept dark hair, clean-shaven face, cream graphic T-shirt with yellow-and-black blocks, light trousers and a slim metal bracelet. A compact silver laptop is a visual motif; keep it tucked in a small dark shoulder sling during ordinary combat so both hands remain free. Complete unseen footwear as gray trainers. Use only the foreground subject and remove other people, labels and logos. The fighting persona and powers are fictional; preserve visible reference features without copying name tags or small shirt lettering.
SIGNATURE SPECIAL MOVE: Compile Crash: Rob snaps a palm forward and launches a compact cyan cluster of angular pixel blocks toward the right, as if a successful build has become a solid energy projectile. The off hand stays near the laptop sling. Keep the pulse close to the palm and the whole body inside the cell.
Preserve the supplied reference identity, outfit and palette while upgrading its rendering to the bold battle-anime art direction above. The off hand stays near the laptop sling. Keep the pulse close to the palm and the whole body inside the cell. Character and attack face RIGHT, complete face and arms, intense expression and tight inked energy accents. Flat uniform chroma green background RGB(0,255,0), no gradient, no floor shadow, no green on the subject, no lettering, borders, watermark, props outside the silhouette or detached debris. All clothing, shoes, soles, skin and accessories are fully opaque in their specified non-green colors: NO green apparel, green footwear, green reflections or translucent green body parts. Chroma green belongs only outside the character. Leave ample clear green padding around the whole subject. Use a solid clean ink silhouette, without a colored outline fringe. Accessories remain attached to the character; exactly one of each visible accessory.
